parameters.query:
-- Legacy TOMO claim. Routing-v2 opportunities are claimed only through claim_lead_opportunity.
WITH claim AS (
  UPDATE auctions
  SET status='claimed', winner_agent_id=$1, claimed_at=NOW()
  WHERE short_code=$2 AND status='open' AND expires_at > NOW()
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_routing_opportunities o
      WHERE o.conversation_id=auctions.conversation_id
        AND o.state NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')
    )
  RETURNING auction_id, conversation_id, property_id, winner_agent_id, notified_agents
)
SELECT c.*, conv.lead_phone, conv.lead_name, pc.payload AS property_payload
FROM claim c
JOIN conversations conv ON conv.conversation_id = c.conversation_id
LEFT JOIN properties_cache pc ON pc.property_id = c.property_id;

UPDATE conversations
SET assigned_agent_id=$1, mode='ai'
WHERE conversation_id=$2::uuid
RETURNING conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, current_property;
SELECT whatsapp_number FROM agents WHERE agent_id = $1;
